citation: Hireko Golf, The Hireko Golf Dynamic Shaft Fitting Index (webinar slide deck, presented 2009-05-01), slides 6 and 7, hosted on SlideShare.

convention.clamp: butt end of the assembled club, head plucked and set in oscillation
convention.club_length: A through X flex at 45 in and L flex at 44 in (Hireko Modern Guide to Shaft Fitting ch. 4, https://www.hirekogolf.com/pub/media/Modern_Guide_to_Shaft_Fitting_chapter4.pdf; the slides state only 'the same given length')
convention.swingweight: L flex measured at C-6; A through X flex at D-1

slope_assumption: L flex is tabulated at 44 in, so it is moved to 45 in with the cited length slope (settings file, 9.3 cpm per inch). The other flexes are compared unconverted.

second_source.citation: Steadfast Golf, replacement driver shaft chart, driver column 45.5 in.
